details:
Q1: Which repository area should be improved?
Choices:
A. Clarify, plan, or implement pipeline (RECOMMENDED)
B. Review/autofix pipeline
C. Orchestrator or validation pipeline
D. Documentation or onboarding
E. Another area — specify it
Q2: What outcome should define “better”?
Choices:
A. Fix a reproducible failure — provide the error/run and expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability, performance, or cost — provide a measurable target
C. Add or change behavior — provide acceptance criteria
D. Improve documentation — identify the audience and current confusion
